description: Deploys item definitions from a source directory to a workspace. Returns per-item success/failure results and duration.
notes: Status values: 'succeeded' (all OK), 'partial_failure' (some items failed), 'no_changes' (everything already in sync). The 'failures' array contains per-item error details with 'change', 'error', and 'code' fields. Post-hooks fire after successful creates/updates (SemanticModel refresh, Environment publish). AUDIT: pass --verify to add a 'verification' block ({converged, checked, discrepancies[], existence_only[]}) that re-fetches the applied items and confirms convergence (content items hash-compared to source, platform-only existence-checked) — report-only, exit code unchanged. Equivalent to re-running 'deploy plan' and expecting all Skip. NOTE the API normalizes hand-authored content (notebooks) on first ingest, so a first deploy may report converged:false; re-deploy from 'deploy export' output to converge. .platform is excluded from the hash, so pure metadata-only changes won't surface as drift.
